Bollywood Actor Nawazuddin Siddiqui joins as Lallantop's Guest in the Newsroom. He talks about Boycott Bollywood trend, Shushant Singh Rajput, National school of Drama, three Khans of bollywood, acting and his struggling days. From starting his acting career to getting his first film. Watch video to all about him.
